gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-figtree: Figtree reads like it was written with a marker tip, its e left wide open at the terminal. Red Hat Display matches that pen-drawn feel with bold, constant-width lines.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-finlandica: Red Hat Display draws every line at a constant width, with daylight inside each curve. Finlandica keeps that outline you can trace with a finger, but its open-mouthed e crossbars suit the finer text.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-fustat: Fustat reads like bent rope, soft and tubular. Its wide gap where the c ends, set against Red Hat Display's marker-like constant-width line, makes both feel drawn by the same confident hand.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-gantari: Gantari looks bent from wire, one continuous gesture across each word. Under Red Hat Display's bold, marker-width headings, its wide c apertures keep a plain sans body feeling friendly and unhurried, paragraph after paragraph.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-gayathri: Approachable is the first word for Gayathri, whose curved letters stay open-ended with a faint letterpress swell. Red Hat Display holds its bold strokes at a constant width like bent pipe, so a modest heading size lets that body contrast show.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-google-sans: Google Sans has no thick-thin shift between its downstrokes and connecting curves, and its terminals pull well back. Red Hat Display, bold and marker-like, sits above it comfortably.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-google-sans-fl: Professional is the mood Google Sans Flex brings, with stroke ends that look cut from one ribbon and every curve finishing in a clean gap. Red Hat Display adds bold, constant-width weight on top.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-gothic-a1: Approachable and professional, Gothic A1 shows its personality in a splayed c terminal. And Red Hat Display, with no hairline thinning anywhere against its stems, gives that body a bold, steady headline above.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-gotu: Gotu brings sturdy hairlines and open-mouthed e crossbars, its stems barely thicker than the connecting strokes. But Red Hat Display's hairline-free, shadow-free strokes are what make the pairing so cleanly modern.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-gowun-dodum: Gowun Dodum reads smooth and tube-like, with a wide mouth in its lowercase a that feels easygoing and clear. Red Hat Display is the bolder voice, while Gowun Dodum stays soft.
